description:
Cable Rows + Full Chest Workout 💪 | Upper, Middle, Lower Chest Training #shorts #gym #chestworkout
Cable Rows ke sath agar aap apna Upper, Middle aur Lower Chest sahi technique se train karte ho, to aapko milega full chest pump aur strong back 💪🔥
Is workout me:
✔ Cable Rows (Back Thickness ke liye)
✔ Incline Press (Upper Chest)
✔ Flat Press / Fly (Middle Chest)
✔ Decline Press / Dips (Lower Chest)
👉 Proper form rakho, slow reps karo aur mind-muscle connection feel karo.
